# Growth Map

> Fractional COO for owner-led businesses doing $1M–$20M. Cameron Oliver gets in the trenches, finds the one thing holding growth back, and fixes it with your team: one map, one scorecard, a weekly rhythm.

Growth Map is the fractional-operator practice of Cameron Oliver. The premise: every business does two things — get customers, and serve them — and when growth stalls the answer is almost always hiding in one of those two. Cameron diagnoses which, fixes the real constraint with the existing team, and builds a simple operating rhythm so the business runs without the owner in the middle of it.

## Start here
- [Home](https://www.growthmap.consulting/): the core message, method, and track record
- [About Cameron Oliver](https://www.growthmap.consulting/about): background and how he works

- [Contact](https://www.growthmap.consulting/contact): book a free 30-minute call

## Who it is for
- Owner-led businesses, roughly $1M to $20M in revenue
- Industries: construction, professional services, healthcare, software/SaaS, agencies, home services
- The owner has become the bottleneck and growth has gotten chaotic

## Services
- Fractional COO / operating partner
- Business diagnosis: finding the real constraint on growth
- Operating model, scorecard, and a weekly cadence the team can hold
- AI tools that take repetitive work off a small team

## For investors
- [Private equity](https://www.growthmap.consulting/investors): an operator to send into a portfolio company that is behind plan
- [Venture](https://www.growthmap.consulting/venture): execution and alignment help for a Series A company
